description: List direct STEP and STL (and DXF where present) download URLs for one object's free files, licensed CC BY 4.0 (credit 'Xem Studio'). Use it when you need files rather than dimensions (get_geometry) or file contents (get_file_content). An object with no free files returns an empty list and a note pointing to its public sources; that is not an error.

filter.description: Keep only files whose name or note contains this text, e.g. 'm3x10' or '2in'.

object.description: Slug as returned by find_geometry or find_by_dimensions, e.g. '4080-aluminum-extrusion'. An exact name or alias also resolves.

name: get_free_files
title: List one object's download links
